content: In Nafsat I, per Melvin-Koushki, Ibn Turka says Ḥakīm Tirmizī posed [157] questions only the elite of the Muḥammadan saints could answer, and that two people answered them: Saʿd al-Dīn Ḥamuvayī in Khurasan and Ibn ʿArabī in the Maghrib. The number 157 is in square brackets in Melvin-Koushki's text.
